purpose: Chapter 1 broad ore field visual study; no collision or material authority

heart_rock.preparation: Pinned Godot 4.7.2 ImporterMesh LOD3 from 59066 source triangles at 60 degrees: 3690 triangles and 1995 referenced vertices, X/Z recentered, Y grounded, tangents generated. Nominal source LOD error 0.066781 m. Albedo and OpenGL normal were Lanczos resized to 512 pixels with linear-light color and normal renormalization; color is quality-0.79 WebP and normal is lossless WebP.

rubble_rock.authors: Greg Zaal, photography; Jenelle van Heerden, modeling
rubble_rock.preparation: Pinned Godot 4.7.2 ImporterMesh LOD3 from 109114 source triangles at 60 degrees: 6818 triangles and 3935 referenced vertices, X/Z recentered, Y grounded, tangents generated. Nominal source LOD error 0.020606 m. Albedo and OpenGL normal were prepared as 512-pixel WebP by the same method as the heart rock.

pebbles.authors: Charlotte Baglioni, photography; Dario Barresi, processing
pebbles.preparation: Lanczos resized in linear light to 768 pixels and encoded as lossy WebP at quality 0.79.

limits: These scans and gravel are presentation assets only. Source glTF files are retained in the task's private asset family, not shipped in the game. A passive render cannot establish player collision, collector clearance, depletion behavior in ordinary play, or performance.
